label: Published closed forms (read): the O(k_perp/Q) SIDIS cross section with the Cahn cos(phi_h) term, Eqs. (38)-(39), and the Sivers asymmetry, Eqs. (64)-(67), of Anselmino et al., hep-ph/0501196v2. The profile's numerical quadrature of the k_perp integrals (Eq. 32 with Eqs. 33-35; Eq. 58 with Eqs. 63 and 68) is compared with them. Closed-form benchmark, not data.

illustrative_reason: the published closed forms are evaluated at the paper's fitted widths (Eq. 47, Table I) used as illustrative settings and a SYNTHETIC N; the formulas, not these numbers, are the benchmark
independence: the closed forms come from the paper's analytic d^2k_perp integration; the profile integrates its own transcription of the same paper's integrands numerically. That follows the same route as the paper, so it checks algebra and transcription, not physics
